why: the seseli plant named only for itself
the one who works at ruling
the movable fence and the leap over it
a word with a stray mark and not a word
the anchusa whose root dyes red
the tool that scrapes the skin clean
the soldier who fights for pay
the erodium with a beak like a bill
the land as it is seen
the beast with a horn on its nose
the working and rising of a brew
